remote_source_if_readiness_requires.provider: Alpaca market-data news and daily SIP bars
remote_source_if_readiness_requires.scope: Missing pre-cutoff earnings-event metadata and split-adjusted daily lineage for the 113 point-in-time QQQ event-registry symbols only

preplan_feasibility_only.note: Schema and coverage counts only; no returns, rankings, or strategy outcomes were inspected before PLAN freeze.

readiness_pull_note: First news pull attempt stopped before artifacts because successful pagination pages were incorrectly counted against the retry budget. The corrected API response included older provider rows despite bounded parameters; it is preserved as an invalid scope artifact and an explicit local-time window filter produces the usable dataset.
market_readiness_note: The first market query was intentionally interrupted by a short process timeout. The second broad catalog minute query failed before artifacts with a Windows file-resource error. Serial exact-date partition reads resolved that infrastructure issue. The local catalog had raw but zero split-adjusted daily rows for the 113-symbol registry, so a targeted 55,975-row Alpaca SIP daily split pull was made for only those symbols through 2026-04-30. This is a disclosed readiness adaptation to the PLAN wording, which had expressly anticipated remote event metadata and exact execution windows but not missing adjustment lineage; it occurred before any return or strategy outcome was inspected.
